items.quote: 8:1 And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying, 8:2 Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and a bullock for the sin offering, and two rams, and a basket of unleavened bread; 8:3 And gather thou all the congregation together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
items.claim: The LORD commanded Moses to take Aaron, his sons, specified ritual items, and gather the entire congregation at the tabernacle entrance
items.object: Aaron and his sons, garments, anointing oil, bullock for the sin offering, two rams, basket of unleavened bread, all the congregation
items.place: the door of the tabernacle of the congregation
